free.text: 1 project, 3 MB, 5,000 visits/mo; log in every 3 months

work.math: No exact total. Pro: $38 a month for up to 500k visits and 100 GB. Pro Max: $89 a month for up to 1 million visits and 200 GB. 100 MB fits storage. 1M requests don't establish visits. Effective cap and tax unclear.

For 1 million API requests and 100 GB out, paid PHP is supported, but resource fit and the required plan are unknown. $38 and $89 are subtotals that depend on account conditions, not complete API prices.
Needs an outside database with 1 GiB of RAM and 10 GB, daily backups kept for 7 days, and 10 GB of traffic. No provider is priced, and the small app API subtotal is not confirmed.
